meta.title: Gospel x Internet — what exists in each people group's language, and how much of their country is online
meta.grain: one row per people group on DOXA's roster
meta.band_rule: yes >=60% · partial 25-59% · no <25% of population using the internet
meta.internet_note: internet_pct is the COUNTRY's figure (World Bank), never the group's. state_internet_* is India's state figure from NFHS-5 (2019-21): the share of women and of men aged 15-49 who have EVER used the internet, kept apart, never averaged, never on a scale with subscriptions per 100.
meta.province_note: province is read from gospel-by-province-groups.json: placed by point-in-polygon on the group's coordinate, which marks a PEOPLE group, not a town. It is approximate, and near a border it can fall on the wrong side; it is never a fact about connectivity in that state.
meta.access_note: access_detail says what exists in the group's OWN language in the sources checked; "none" means nothing was found there, never that nothing exists. access_level: own = something in their language; bridge = nothing in their language but a bridge, candidate or Deaf way in; zero = neither.

platforms.messaging_source: Apple App Store RSS — top free apps by country
platforms.ios_caveat: iOS ONLY. Most of these countries are Android-majority and Google publishes no keyless equivalent, so this is one eye open. An app absent here is NOT absent in-country. 50 of 175 countries have no Apple storefront.
platforms.ranking_caveat: A top-free RANK is most-DOWNLOADED recently, not most-used.
platforms.classification_caveat: kind is a name-keyword HEURISTIC over a known list, not a verified taxonomy.
platforms.social_measures: share of page-view referrals among tracked social platforms
platforms.social_caveat: MESSAGING APPS ARE NOT MEASURED. WhatsApp/Telegram/WeChat/Signal/Viber generate few web referrals but may be THE dominant channel in several of these countries. A low total here means little web-referral traffic, NOT that people are offline.

meta.never_read: engagement, workers, teams, agencies: who works where is not shown (a safety default, pending a product decision).
